title: OpenAI Safety Employee Quits, Calls for Nuclear-Level Safeguards
summary: An OpenAI employee focused on AI safety has quit the company and warned that top artificial intelligence firms aren’t doing enough to mitigate the technology’s risks, joining a growing chorus of employees raising alarms from within the industry.

title: War, Cyber Attack May Spark Next Financial Crisis, RBI Says
summary: The next financial crisis could originate from a source outside the world of finance, Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said Saturday.

title: Taiwan Foreign Minister to Visit Arizona to Deepen Economic Ties
summary: Taiwan’s foreign minister is set to visit Arizona for meetings with local officials and semiconductor companies, underscoring Taipei’s effort to deepen economic ties with the US as President Donald Trump seeks to stabilize relations with China.

title: NYU's Gary Marcus on AI development concerns
summary: Gary Marcus, Robust AI Inc. co-founder and former CEO, argues that developers, including OpenAI, lack sufficient safeguards for systems they can't reliably control. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max AT&T Glitch Requires Device Replacements
summary: Apple Inc. said “a small number” of AT&T Inc. customers who recently upgraded to the company’s iPhone 18 Pro Max will need to replace their devices after a bug caused them to lose cellular service.

title: Apple to Tighten Mac Data Controls in Guard Against AI Agents
summary: Apple Inc. said it plans to introduce new privacy controls for Mac users, warning of the growing risks around granting broad data access to third-party software, including artificial intelligence agents.

title: Nvidia Falls Short of May Record as Value Nears $6 Trillion
summary: Nvidia Corp. shares touched an intraday high for the first time since May before trimming those gains and closing just short of a record as investors piled back into the stock after a two-month selloff that wiped out more than $1 trillion of market value.

title: Nscale Hires Meta’s Justin Osofsky to Be COO Ahead of IPO
summary: Nscale, the artificial intelligence infrastructure company, hired a long-time Meta Platforms Inc. executive to be its chief operating officer, to accelerate a rapid expansion connected to its upcoming initial public offering, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: Colombia Has Started Payments on €3.1 Billion Saab Fighter Deal
summary: Colombia has begun paying for a €3.1 billion fleet of Saab fighter jets ordered by the previous government, complicating any attempt by President Abelardo de la Espriella to unwind the purchase as he struggles to repair the nation’s finances.

title: Hackers Breached Propulsion System of US-Bound Oil Tanker
summary: FBI and US Coast Guard investigators have found evidence that hackers accessed the propulsion system of an oil supertanker as it was approaching the Texas coast this summer, according to US officials familiar with the matter, an extraordinary breach that highlights the growing physical risks from cyberattacks.

title: Fed’s Kashkari Says AI Not Only Driver of US Growth
summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis President Neel Kashkari said he was skeptical of the argument that the US economy is shrinking but for a boom in construction related to artificial intelligence.

title: A Guide to This Fall’s Video Games
summary: From ‘Big Walk’ to ‘Grand Theft Auto VI,’ we’ve got you covered

title: US Hackers Face $1,000-a-Month Pay Cuts in Controversial Plan
summary: US soldiers tasked with hacking American adversaries and defending the nation’s computers are set to see their incentive pay cut by as much as $12,000 a year as part of a broader overhaul that’s drawn ire from the ranks, according to documents reviewed by Bloomberg and people familiar with the situation.

title: Divergent Targets Faster, Cheaper Defense Production
summary: Divergent CEO Lukas Czinger says advanced manufacturing can help the Pentagon build weapons faster, cheaper and at far greater scale. Working with Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works and other defense contractors, Divergent uses technologies including 3D printing to move from engineering inputs to flight-ready hardware in under three months. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lockheed Taps OpenAI to Solve F-35 Challenges
summary: Lockheed Martin is taking a model-agnostic approach to AI, using 55 different large language models across its business while applying the technology to everything from internal operations to autonomous weapons systems. SVP of Technology and Strategic Innovation Sarah Hiza discusses how Lockheed tests AI before deploying it, the growing role of autonomy and crewed-uncrewed teaming, and reveals that OpenAI is working alongside the F-35 team to tackle complex math and physics challenges tied to advanced sensor capabilities. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bloomberg Defense Tech Special 10/02/2026
summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow is live from Skunk Works, Lockheed Martin's advanced aircraft development facility in Southern California. Lockheed Martin's OJ Sanchez and Sarah Hiza weigh in on the company’s road to innovation in the defense tech space, Fortem CEO Jon Gruen discusses the drone warfare landscape, and Divergent CEO Lukas Czinger explains how the startup is helping build weapons faster, cheaper and at far greater scale. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lockheed Backs Fortem’s Counter-Drone Push
summary: Fortem has raised $50 million in Series B funding, with Lockheed Martin participating as the counter-drone company looks to rapidly expand manufacturing and bookings. CEO Jon Gruen discusses how the partnership with Lockheed has evolved from venture investment to deploying technology together, and lessons learned from operating in active conflict zones. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: James Manyika on AI Regulation
summary:
"I don't think it should be left to any one company."

Google SVP James Manyika says a "collective effort" is needed to ensure AI safety. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Inside Skunk Works: Lockheed’s Bet on Vectis
summary: From inside Lockheed Martin’s storied Skunk Works, Aeronautics President OJ Sanchez discusses the company’s push to move faster on the next generation of air power. He explains why Lockheed is investing ahead of formal Pentagon requirements in its autonomous Vectis aircraft, and how a single F-35 could eventually control as many as eight Vectis drones. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Google Hikes Price of Budget Pixel 10a Phone to $599 on Memory Costs
summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google raised the price of its seven-month-old Pixel 10a smartphone by $100 to $599, another example of how rising memory costs are making even older devices more expensive.
